reports.student_reply: Hey! The correct angle comes from setting the maximum height equal to the horizontal range: (u² sin²θ)/(2g) = (u² sin2θ)/g → tanθ = 4, so θ = tan⁻¹4. The answer tan⁻¹2 would arise from a slip in the algebra. Your effort is great—just watch the factor of 2 in the height formula. Keep it up!
